decision: Tightened position and daily loss limits, raised conviction threshold, and re‑allocated capital toward winning teams to protect equity after a broadly negative day.

Paused Space team due to persistent losses and low win rate. Tightened risk limits (lower max position size, higher conviction threshold, lower trade cap) to reduce churn and forced low-quality entries. Reallocated capital from Space to Defense and Financials to strengthen the portfolio's core.
